newsitem.title: USA: Reptron files for 3 million common shares.
newsitem.headline: Reptron files for 3 million common shares.

text.p: Reptron Electronics Inc filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to three million common shares.

Of the total amount, 2.2 million common will be sold by the company and 800,000 common shares by selling stockholders. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 8,271,019 shares, the filing said.

The underwriters will be offered a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 450,000 additional shares. The offering will be made through Prudential Securities Inc, Robert W. Baird & Co Inc, Stephens Inc and Needham & Co Inc.
Net proceeds will be used to repay borrowings outstanding under the company's revolving credit facility, Reptron said.

Reptron, based in Tampa, Fla., is a leading integrated electronics company providing both value-added distribution of electronic components and targeted contract manufacturing services through its two divisions: Reptron Distribution and K-Byte Manufacturing.
